language.title: Choose your language

language.previewNote: Note: Hindi and English are currently fully translated. Other regional languages will follow standard fallback.

stateSelect.title: Select your state
stateSelect.subtitle: Choose your state or union territory
stateSelect.speakerText: Please select your state from the grid below to view nearby procurement centers.

cropSelect.title: Select your crop
cropSelect.subtitle: Choose one or more crops
cropSelect.speakerText: Please select your crops from the categories below.

privacy.title: Your information is protected
privacy.disclaimer: This application is designed in line with the principles of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
privacy.speakerText: Your information is protected. We collect minimal details only for slot booking and digital token generation. Your data is never sold.
privacy.collectBody: Your name, mobile number, village/district, crop type, land size, and masked ID details.
privacy.whyBody: To schedule your mandi procurement slot, issue a verified token with QR code, and send SMS alerts.
privacy.whoBody: Only authorized officials at your chosen grain procurement center. No data is sold to private advertisers.
privacy.protectBody: Your identification number is masked with only the last 4 digits stored for verification.
privacy.rightsBody: You can inspect your data, withdraw consent, or request complete deletion at any time from Settings.
privacy.retentionBody: Data is retained only for the duration of the procurement cycle and payment settlement.
privacy.fullLegalNotice: Issued under principles consistent with Sections 5 & 6 of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your informed consent is required to proceed and can be revoked anytime.
privacy.disagreeModalTitle: Consent Required for Online Slot Booking
privacy.disagreeModalDesc: Basic identification details are required to generate digital slots and QR tokens. You may still visit the mandi center directly to join the manual walk-in queue.

registration.title: Farmer Registration
registration.subtitle: Quick registration in simple steps
registration.speakerText: Please complete the registration steps with your mobile number, location, and crop details.
registration.kisanCardHelp: Uploading your card auto-fills your name and details. Used strictly for verification.
registration.cardSecurityNote: Only last 4 digits are retained securely.

home.statusBannerNone: Today's slot bookings are open. Tap below to book.

centers.title: Nearby Centers
centers.subtitle: Choose procurement center by distance and live crowd
centers.speakerText: Procurement centers are listed below. Choose a low-crowd center to save waiting time.
centers.smartSuggestionBody: Nearest center is crowded. Center at 4 km has faster lines.
centers.walkInNotice: 15% slot capacity is reserved for non-digital walk-in farmers.

booking.title: Book Slot
booking.speakerText: Please select a date and time slot for your produce delivery.
booking.confirmNotice: Please arrive 15 minutes before your scheduled slot.

token.speakerText: Your slot is confirmed. Your token number is {{token}}. Show this QR code at the center gate.
token.qrScanHint: Scan this code at mandi entrance
token.smsNotice: A copy of this token has been sent to your mobile via SMS.

queue.title: Live Queue
queue.speakerText: Currently serving Token {{current}}. Your token is {{myToken}}. There are {{ahead}} farmers ahead of you. Estimated wait is {{wait}} minutes.
queue.turnReadyNotification: Your turn is ready! Please proceed to Gate #1.
queue.urgentNotification: Your turn is approaching in ~30 mins. Head to the gate.

tracker.speakerText: Track quality inspection, weighing, digital J-Form receipt, and bank deposit.

settings.title: Settings & Privacy
settings.speakerText: Manage your language, view privacy principles, or request data management.
settings.logoutConfirmDesc: You will return to the portal choice page. Your saved data is preserved.
settings.withdrawConsentDesc: Withdrawing consent resets online slot access.
settings.deleteDataDesc: Permanently remove your profile, bookings, passes, and waitlist entries.
settings.deleteStep1Desc: Everything will be permanently removed from AgriMinds, including your profile, bookings, tokens, and waitlist entries. This action cannot be undone.
settings.deleteStep2Desc: Are you completely sure? Tap below to permanently delete all your data and reset the app.
